description: 03 § 6's interpolation, pinned across the SDKs (#1398). `angle`: interpolateAngle(from, to, t, bits) over decoded angle values — in code space, Δ = wrap_b(q1 − q0), q0 + t·Δ re-wrapped and decoded — must equal `value`. `quat3`: interpolateQuat3(from, to, t) over decoded rotations — the shorter hemisphere (`to` negated when the dot product is negative), then a normalized lerp — must equal `value` (x, y, z, w). Every double is its IEEE bits as 16 hex digits.
